correctness.rationale: The graph Q3 has 8 binary vertices and 12 edges. The complex generated by nine perfect matchings has 99 nonempty faces, f-vector (12,42,36,9), with a nine-facet good cover whose 9-vertex nerve has 24 edges and 12 triangles. The source verifier constructs twelve free-triangle/edge collapses, leaving a connected nine-vertex twelve-edge graph with rank 4 H1 and no higher homology, so K≃∨4 S1. Independent direct code enumerated the nine perfect matchings, all 99 nonempty faces, and all 48 signed cube automorphisms, computed signed simplicial Lefschetz traces on original faces, and confirmed for every element χ_H1(g_{b,σ})=sgn σ+sum_{σ(j)=j}(-1)^{b_j}; trace counts {4:1,2:3,1:16,0:15,-2:13}. This fixes the rational character as the sum of the 1-dimensional permutation-sign and irreducible signed-coordinate 3-dimensional representation; the central full bit-flip has trace -2. Nerve lemma and Hopf trace are standard; this finite result does not assert higher cubes or an integral splitting.
